verdict.rationale: Component testing and AI-assisted tooling are fair questions for a UI framework's ecosystem, so this axis applies. The pack has no evidence of any test utilities, a testing guide, or AI-driven test generation from declared props or reactive state. The llms.txt probe only shows that docs are exposed to LLMs in general, and the 'Tooling Guide' entry is a bare title that never mentions testing, so neither supports this story.
